messages.subject: variable hjust/vjust
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to build a graph, with labels for certain points displayed through geom_text. In order not to obscure both the label and the points, I use hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5 in geom_text.

However, the lines (built with geom_path) on the graph go mostly horizontally, and then turn upward. Thus, hjust/vjust of 0.5 is ok for one part of the graph, but wrong for the other. Since I'm doing all this programmatically (there are many graphs to build), is there a way to recognize when to use what setting of hjust/vjust?

Hope I was clear,
Thanks,
Nikola

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: variable hjust/vjust
parts:
You could compute the slope of the line for your last few points and through trial and error build a subfunction that builds a vector of hjust and vjust for your graph. 

Start by plotting a bunch of lines and figuring out which adjustments look best, then correlate that to a slope, then build the subfunction. 

Shouldn't be hard, but will take time.

Brandon
